title: Add Permit Number + Furnishing Status (all options) + Washroom Count to listings and Agent Arena

requirements.text: Extend the backend Property model and create/update params to store (a) permit number, (b) furnishing status with all options (Furnished, Semi-Furnished, Unfurnished), and (c) number of washrooms; ensure these fields are returned by all public property query methods and by getPropertyById.

quotes: please add the furnished , unfurnished filter option in front end and show number of washroom in listings add option in back end to add number of washroom and furnishing status.
include all option and add listing permit number in front end and add option to enter permit number in back end

acceptanceCriteria: Backend Property type includes new fields for permit number, furnishing status, and washrooms.
Backend CreatePropertyParams (and the update path) accepts the new fields and persists them on create/update.
All property query functions (getAllProperties, getPropertiesBy*, getPropertyById, etc.) return the new fields to the frontend without trapping or omitting them.

requirements.text: Update the Agent Arena property create/edit form to allow agents to input Permit Number, select Furnishing Status (Furnished / Semi-Furnished / Unfurnished), and enter Washrooms (number), and ensure these values are sent in create/update mutations to the backend.

quotes: add option in back end to add number of washroom and furnishing status
add option to enter permit number in back end

acceptanceCriteria: On /agent/properties/new and /agent/properties/edit/:id, the form includes fields labeled in English: "Permit Number", "Furnishing Status", and "Washrooms".
Furnishing Status offers exactly 3 options: Furnished, Semi-Furnished, Unfurnished.
Creating a property saves these values; editing a property pre-fills the fields from existing listing data and saving updates them.
If required validation is applied, validation messages (if any) are in English.

requirements.text: Display Permit Number, Furnishing Status, and Washrooms on the public frontend listings UI, including the listing card and the listing details page, using clear English labels.

quotes: show number of washroom in listings
add listing permit number in front end

acceptanceCriteria: Property cards show the washrooms count and/or permit number in a readable way without breaking the existing layout.
Listing details page shows Permit Number, Furnishing Status, and Washrooms with English labels.
If a listing is missing one of these values (e.g., older data), the UI handles it gracefully (e.g., hides the row or shows "N/A" in English) without crashing.

requirements.text: Add a public search filter for Furnishing Status to the existing PropertySearchBar and make search results respect this filter when applied.

quotes: please add the furnished , unfurnished filter option in front end

acceptanceCriteria: Public search UI includes a "Furnishing Status" filter with options: Furnished, Semi-Furnished, Unfurnished (and an empty/unset state).

When Furnishing Status is selected and the user clicks "Search Properties", the results list updates to include only listings matching that furnishing status (in addition to any other active filters).
When Furnishing Status is not selected, results behavior remains unchanged from before this update.
All user-facing text for this filter is in English.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor with all logic in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).
Only create/update/delete property operations must remain protected by the Agent Code "050702"; public listing queries must remain publicly accessible.
Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed in frontend.immutablePaths; compose those components instead.
Use English for all user-facing text.
nonGoals: Do not change the fixed WhatsApp number (+971 553723617).
Do not add third-party authentication or external databases.
Do not redesign unrelated parts of the UI beyond what is necessary to add the new fields/filters.
